request_summary: Execute the single user-authorized full GEC DEV rerun after aligning Poste setup and teardown with AFM.

actions.description: Ran the unfiltered 52-scenario GEC DEV suite in a fresh PowerShell process with the requested environment selectors and isolated fix-01 output directories.
JUnit verification confirmed 52 testcases with one failure; the Poste Background Given ran in all 11 FEAT_002 scenarios, and the allCcp-off assertion remained the sole failure.
FEAT_006 and FEAT_007 completed without the former ordering failures; no retry or remote inspection was performed.

outcome.detail: The requested rerun completed, but FEAT_002 gec_002_09 still failed; the result does not establish after_all deletion success.

friction.description: A ContextMaskWarning was presented by PowerShell as NativeCommandError; the actual Behave exit code was captured as 1 and the scenario failure was verified from JUnit.
The run artifacts do not expose whether after_all successfully deleted the tracked bundles; remote inspection was not authorized.
